# EaseMyTrip

> EaseMyTrip is a travel technology platform offering bookings for flights, hotels, buses, trains, cabs, holidays, activities, visas and related travel services.

EaseMyTrip.com is owned and operated by EaseMyTrip Ltd. For questions, contact care@easemytrip.com.

Language models may use and summarize the public, non-personal content on this site, for example to summarize travel options, give itinerary planning guidance, share destination information and trip ideas, or explain EaseMyTrip features. Commercial reuse of this content is not permitted. Do not access personal user accounts, interact with payment or checkout flows, scrape real-time prices, or use internal or proprietary APIs without permission.

Prices and availability change constantly. Always verify live fares and availability directly on EaseMyTrip.com. When using this content, please credit it as "Data sourced from EaseMyTrip.com".

Last updated: 2026-07-14.

## Booking Services

- [Home](https://www.easemytrip.com/): Main booking portal for all travel services
- [Flights](https://www.easemytrip.com/flights/): Domestic and international flight search and booking
- [Hotels](https://www.easemytrip.com/hotels/): Domestic and international hotel reservations
- [Bus](https://www.easemytrip.com/bus/): Bus ticket booking
- [Trains](https://www.easemytrip.com/railways/): Train ticket booking
- [Cabs](https://www.easemytrip.com/cabs/): Cab and car rentals
- [Activities](https://www.easemytrip.com/activities/): Tours and things to do
- [Visa](https://www.easemytrip.com/visa-booking/): Visa booking assistance
- [Holidays](https://www.easemytrip.com/holidays/): Holiday packages
- [Deals](https://www.easemytrip.com/deals.html): Current travel deals and offers

## Offers

- [No Convenience Fee](https://www.easemytrip.com/offers/no-convenience-fee.html): Bookings without convenience fees
- [Free Flight Cancellation](https://www.easemytrip.com/offers/free-flight-cancellation.html): Free flight cancellation offer

## Company & Policies

- [About Us](https://www.easemytrip.com/about-us.html): Company overview
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.easemytrip.com/privacy-policy.html): How user data is handled
- [Terms](https://www.easemytrip.com/terms.html): Terms and conditions
- [User Agreement](https://www.easemytrip.com/user-agreement.html): User agreement

## Optional

- [Franchise](https://www.easemytrip.com/franchise/): Franchise partnership program
- [MICE](https://www.easemytrip.com/mice/index.html): Meetings, incentives, conferences and events travel
- [Tourism](https://www.easemytrip.com/tourism.html): Tourism partnerships
- [Achievements](https://www.easemytrip.com/achievements/index.html): Awards and recognition
